# Finding codes

Every problem pycuf notices is a finding with a stable code. Codes are never renumbered or reused. The severity shown is the default; change it with `severity_overrides`.


## CUF1xxx: Input and character encoding

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CUF1001` | INFO | Byte-order mark present |
| `CUF1002` | INFO | No XML declaration; encoding assumed to be UTF-8 |
| `CUF1004` | INFO | Encoding overridden by the caller |
| `CUF1006` | WARNING | Bytes undefined in the encoding kept as Latin-1 characters |
| `CUF1010` | WARNING | Repair: XML-illegal control characters removed |
| `CUF1012` | WARNING | Repair: bare ampersands escaped |
| `CUF1013` | WARNING | Data after the end of the document ignored |

## CUF2xxx: XML well-formedness and security

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CUF2001` | ERROR | XML is not well-formed |
| `CUF2002` | ERROR | Forbidden construct (DOCTYPE/ENTITY) |
| `CUF2003` | ERROR | Safety limit exceeded |

## CUF3xxx: Structure and values

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CUF3001` | INFO | CUF version |
| `CUF3002` | WARNING | CUF version is not 4.003 |
| `CUF3010` | ERROR | Required element missing |
| `CUF3011` | WARNING | Element not defined in CUF-XML 4.003 |
| `CUF3012` | INFO | Attribute not defined in CUF-XML 4.003 (vendor extension) |
| `CUF3013` | ERROR | Element not allowed in this place |
| `CUF3014` | ERROR | Element occurs more often than allowed |
| `CUF3015` | ERROR | Element out of order |
| `CUF3016` | ERROR | Required attribute missing |
| `CUF3017` | WARNING | Required attribute is empty |
| `CUF3018` | ERROR | Invalid number |
| `CUF3019` | ERROR | Invalid date or date-time |
| `CUF3020` | ERROR | Invalid boolean |
| `CUF3021` | ERROR | Value not in the allowed code list |
| `CUF3022` | INFO | Software house (SYSTEEMHUIS) not in the 4.003 list |
| `CUF3023` | WARNING | Text content inside an element ignored |
| `CUF3024` | INFO | Legacy sort-code attribute (SC1–SC6) read as a sort code |
| `CUF3025` | INFO | Sort codes written as attributes read as sort codes |

## CUF4xxx: Sort codes

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CUF4001` | WARNING | Sort code used but its SORTERING is not declared in SORTEERCODES |
| `CUF4002` | INFO | SORTERING declared but never used |
| `CUF4003` | WARNING | SORTERING declared more than once |
| `CUF4004` | INFO | Sort code value not in the declared code table |

## CUF5xxx: Stated totals against computed totals

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `CUF5001` | WARNING | Bundle total differs from the computed total |
| `CUF5002` | WARNING | Estimate total differs from the computed total |
| `CUF5003` | INFO | Stated totals are all zero although the lines have costs |
| `CUF5004` | WARNING | Resource lines do not add up to their estimate line |
| `CUF5005` | INFO | Contract sum differs from direct costs plus tail items |
| `CUF5006` | INFO | Estimate line priced from its resource lines |
